phase: DRP3 / DRP12 gate — Airflow runtime lineage
host: i-0fb5f608a7bc37002 (kafka-dev-lab-dev-airflow, k3s), reached via SSM Session Manager
method: isolated pod from the DEPLOYED image apache/airflow:3.2.2 with an ephemeral sqlite metadata DB. The resident scheduler was NOT touched: all 8 production pods stayed Running throughout.

defect_found.summary: AIRFLOW__OPENLINEAGE__TRANSPORT was the bare string `console`; the provider parses that key as JSON
defect_found.error: AirflowConfigException: Unable to parse [openlineage] 'transport' as valid json
defect_found.why_it_was_silent: the exception is raised while the PLUGIN IS BEING IMPORTED, so Airflow skips the plugin, registers no listener, and every task still succeeds. The probe DAG ran green with REGISTERED_LISTENERS = [] and emitted nothing.
defect_found.why_the_tests_missed_it: the existing test asserted only that airflow/helm/values.yaml matched cdc/lineage_runtime.py::airflow_env(). Both carried the bare string, so they agreed — and agreement between two things I wrote is not evidence about the third thing that has to consume them.
defect_found.fix: airflow_env() now emits json.dumps({'type': ...}); values.yaml carries '{"type":"console"}'; three tests added that parse the value the way the provider does
defect_found.note: this is NOT the Spark shape — the Spark listener takes a flat spark.openlineage.transport.type=console string

after_fix.breakdown: 3 tasks x START/COMPLETE = 6, plus 1 DAG-level COMPLETE

parent_run_facet.significance: this is the hole the docs recorded: every task run now carries parent.run.runId pointing at the DAG run, and root pointing at the same, so an Airflow-submitted Spark job is no longer an orphan in the graph

proves: provider 2.20.2 loads on the deployed Airflow 3.2.2 — the DRP0 open constraint about the provider major is closed with a real load, not a version-compatibility claim
the listener registers and emits real RunEvents for real task executions
the namespace the provider stamps equals the one cdc/lineage_runtime.py derives
the parent/root run facets link task runs to their DAG run
does_not_prove: that the RESIDENT scheduler emits. The provider is not in the image, and chart 1.22.0 removed `extraPipPackages`, so making this permanent needs a custom Airflow image — see the command list in docs/validation/DATA_RELIABILITY_E2E.md
dataset-level input/output lineage from Airflow: PythonOperator has no extractor, so inputs/outputs are empty. Dataset lineage comes from the Spark listener, which has 12 real events.
cost: $0 — one short-lived pod on an already-running instance
